description_en: Removes access permissions for a gateway. The removed IP address ranges no longer have access to the gateway
description_zh: 删除网关的访问权限，删除的IP段不再具备访问网关的权限
kebab_example: aliyun eas delete-acl-policy --cluster-id cn-wulanchabu --gateway-id gw-1uhcqmsc7x22000000 --region cn-hangzhou
name: DeleteAclPolicy

parameters.help_en: The region of the private gateway
parameters.name: cluster_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the private gateway. This operation supports only FullyManaged (non-ALB backend) gateways. If you call this operation for an ALB backend gateway, an InvalidParameter error is returned. You can call the ListGateway operation and set GatewayType to FullyManaged to filter FullyManaged gateways
parameters.help_zh: 私有网关ID。本接口仅支持 FullyManaged（非 ALB 后端）类型网关；ALB 后端网关调用时会返回 InvalidParameter。可通过 ListGateway 筛选 GatewayType=FullyManaged 的网关
parameters.name: gateway_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the VPC. For information about how to obtain the VPC ID, see DescribeVpcs
parameters.help_zh: 专有网络的ID。如何获取专有网络ID，请参见DescribeVpcs
parameters.name: vpc_id

fields.help_en: The comment for the IP address range that is allowed to access the VPC
fields.help_zh: 专有网络可访问IP段备注
fields.name: comment

fields.help_en: The IP address range that is allowed to access the VPC
fields.name: entry

parameters.help_en: The whitelist of IP address ranges that are allowed to access the VPC. This parameter is required. If this parameter is not specified, an InvalidParameter error is returned, indicating that AclPolicyList must be set
parameters.help_zh: 专有网络可访问 IP 段白名单列表。此参数实际为必填项，未提供时会返回 InvalidParameter（AclPolicyList must be set）
parameters.name: acl_policy_list

GatewayId.description_en: The ID of the private gateway

Message.description_en: The message returned in the response
Message.example: Successfully delete acl policy for gateway
